headline: NICE TO MEET YOU!
name: Petr Bílek
tagline: Wanderer who ended up developing web apps

experience.description: Hello there! My name is Petr Bílek. I am a frontend developer, who values clean and efficient solutions. I love minimalistic approach — both in my design and in my life. Oh yes, I do like gradients and animations.

projects.description: I’m not a geek. Coding ain’t my life. Nonetheless I do really enjoy the process of learning new stuff, technologies and to challenge myself. And if I’m offline, chances are you’ll bump into me in the mountains.

quote: Beautiful things don’t ask for attention
